description: Index usage ops view: hot indexes (reads/seeks/scans/lookups), scan & write ratios, unused/write-heavy drop candidates, and per-DB rollup. Stats reset on restart. Not fragmentation.

targets.expr: count(count by (instance) (mssql_index_usage_reads{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} or mssql_index_usage_db_reads{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})) or vector(0)

count(count by (instance, db) (mssql_index_usage_db_reads{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} or mssql_index_usage_reads{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})) or vector(0)

max(mssql_index_usage_db_scan_ratio{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} or mssql_index_usage_scan_ratio{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}) or vector(0)

sum(mssql_index_usage_db_reads{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}) or sum(mssql_index_usage_reads{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}) or vector(0)

sum(mssql_index_usage_db_updates{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}) or sum(mssql_index_usage_updates{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}) or vector(0)
max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, index_name, index_type_desc) (mssql_index_usage_reads{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, index_name, index_type_desc) (mssql_index_usage_seeks{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, index_name, index_type_desc) (mssql_index_usage_scans{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, index_name, index_type_desc) (mssql_index_usage_lookups{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, index_name, index_type_desc) (mssql_index_usage_updates{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, index_name, index_type_desc) (mssql_index_usage_scan_ratio{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, index_name, index_type_desc) (mssql_index_usage_lookup_ratio{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, index_name, index_type_desc) (mssql_index_usage_write_read_ratio{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})

panels.title: Hot indexes - seeks / scans / lookups / updates / ratios

targets.expr: max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, index_name, index_type_desc, candidate_kind) (mssql_index_usage_stale_updates{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", candidate_kind=~"${candidate_kind:regex}"})

max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, index_name, index_type_desc, candidate_kind) (mssql_index_usage_stale_reads{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", candidate_kind=~"${candidate_kind:regex}"})

max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, index_name, index_type_desc, candidate_kind) (mssql_index_usage_stale_write_read_ratio{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", candidate_kind=~"${candidate_kind:regex}"})
